products.name: Ollama
products.note: Local LLM runner; self-hosted; no data exfiltration; model supply-chain verification needed

profile_text.body:
Ollama is a software project that describes itself as a tool for running open AI models locally, with an emphasis on keeping user data private. According to its own site, it is designed to let users bring open models into their workflows by launching agents from the Ollama command-line interface or connecting editors and frameworks through its API.

The company's primary product, also called Ollama, is categorized as an open-source and self-hosted local large language model runner. Because models run on the user's own hardware, no data is sent to external servers, though the held facts note that model supply-chain verification is a consideration for users evaluating the platform. No litigation, patent filings, or MCP server registrations are recorded for the company in the available data.
